code = bytearray()
labels = {}
fixups = []

def emit(*b):
    code.extend(b)

def label(name):
    labels[name] = len(code)

def jump(op, name):
    emit(op, 0, 0)
    fixups.append((len(code)-2, name))

def push(v):
    emit(0x01, v & 0xFF, (v >> 8) & 0xFF)

def push65537():
    push(1); push(16); emit(0x1A); push(1); emit(0x10)  # (1<<16)+1

def load(i): emit(0x02, i)
def store(i): emit(0x03, i)

# vars: 2=r_old, 3=r, 4=s_old, 5=s, 6=q, 7=tmp
push65537(); store(2)
load(0); store(3)
push(0); store(4)
push(1); store(5)

label('loop')
load(3); jump(0x31, 'end')          # if r==0 goto end
load(2); load(3); emit(0x13); store(6)        # q = r_old / r
load(2); load(6); load(3); emit(0x12); emit(0x11); store(7)  # tmp = r_old - q*r
load(3); store(2)                   # r_old = r
load(7); store(3)                   # r = tmp
load(4); load(6); load(5); emit(0x12); emit(0x11); store(7)  # tmp = s_old - q*s
load(5); store(4)                   # s_old = s
load(7); store(5)                   # s = tmp
jump(0x30, 'loop')

label('end')
load(4); push65537(); emit(0x14)    # s_old % 65537
emit(0x04)                          # dup
push(0); emit(0x22)                 # x < 0 ?
jump(0x31, 'store')                 # if not negative, store
push65537(); emit(0x10)             # add 65537
label('store')
store(1); emit(0x00)

for pos, name in fixups:
    addr = labels[name]
    code[pos] = addr & 0xFF
    code[pos+1] = (addr >> 8) & 0xFF

open('/app/prog.bin','wb').write(bytes(code))
print('size:', len(code))
